title: Cozy Bungalow Apartment in South Inglewood
description:
Cozy South Inglewood bungalow just 10 minutes from downtown Nashville with easy freeway access. Enjoy the neighborhood’s relaxed, creative vibe and view the beautiful willow tree from your private balcony. Shelby Bottoms Greenway — a short drive or bike ride away — offers miles of scenic trails and river views. Dedicated workspace with fast fiber Wi-Fi makes it perfect for weekend couples or remote stays. YMCA within walking distance.

Other things to note
Third-party bookings are not permitted. The person making the reservation must be present for the duration of the stay.

Parties and events are strictly prohibited.

The apartment can accommodate up to 6 people during the day; however, a maximum of 4 guests are permitted to stay overnight. All guests must be registered during the booking process.

Access to the rear of the property is not permitted.

Please note: ceiling height is slightly lower than standard. Guests taller than a typical door frame height may find the space less comfortable.
